vi: Design DynamoDB single-table schema với overload partition key/sort key cho nhiều entity (User, Order, OrderItem) dùng prefix (USER#, ORDER#, ITEM#).
Viết Terraform khai báo DynamoDB table + GSI (Global Secondary Index) cho access pattern inverse, cấu hình billing_mode on-demand vs provisioned, chạy fmt/validate.
Cấu hình DAX cluster (Dynamic Accelerator) in-VPC cache write-through cho hot read, hiểu tại sao DAX không free-tier, giảm latency ms xuống microsecond.
So sánh cost model DynamoDB on-demand (tính/request) vs provisioned (tính/RCU-WCU), hiểu vì sao single-table vs multi-table ảnh hưởng RCU chi phí.
Design access pattern trước, sau đó nặn key schema để phục vụ từng pattern bằng đúng 1 query, thay vì copy Postgres relational model sang NoSQL.
en: Design a DynamoDB single-table schema with overloaded partition and sort keys for multiple entities (User, Order, OrderItem) using prefixes (USER#, ORDER#, ITEM#).
Write Terraform declaring a DynamoDB table plus GSI (Global Secondary Index) for inverse access patterns, configure billing_mode on-demand vs provisioned, and run fmt/validate.
Set up a DAX cluster (DynamoDB Accelerator) as an in-VPC write-through cache for hot reads; understand why DAX has no free tier and reduces latency from milliseconds to microseconds.
Compare DynamoDB cost models: on-demand (billed per request) vs provisioned (billed per RCU-WCU); understand why single-table vs multi-table affects RCU cost.
Design access patterns first, then shape the key schema to serve each pattern with exactly one Query, instead of copying Postgres relational design to NoSQL.
